quality_guards: Acetylene risk depends on cylinder condition, pressure, equipment design, ventilation, ignition sources, process, handling and emergency arrangements.
Acetylene evidence is cylinder-, process-, equipment-, workplace- and incident-specific and is not an exact parcel-level explosion probability.
LPG risk depends on inventory, tank and pipe condition, siting, low points, ventilation, ignition sources, traffic, maintenance and emergency response.
LPG evidence is installation-, inventory-, site-, equipment- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire or explosion probability.
Petrol risk depends on stored quantity, container or tank integrity, transfer method, vapour control, ignition sources, drainage, traffic and supervision.
Petrol evidence is site-, storage-, dispensing-, container-, task- and weather-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Kitchen carbon-monoxide risk depends on fuel, appliance condition, flue performance, ventilation, room volume, operating pattern, maintenance and occupancy.
Commercial-kitchen evidence is appliance-, fuel-, ventilation-, premises- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level poisoning probability.
Oxygen risk depends on concentration, leakage, ventilation, equipment cleanliness, materials, pressure, ignition sources and confined-space conditions.
Oxygen evidence is equipment-, concentration-, material-, task- and environment-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Cylinder risk depends on gas properties, pressure, valve protection, restraint, storage layout, ventilation, transport method and emergency arrangements.
Cylinder evidence is gas-, package-, pressure-, handling-, vehicle- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level release probability.
Biogas risk depends on feedstock, digestion stage, gas composition, plant integrity, ventilation, maintenance, ignition sources, confined spaces and emergency capability.
Biogas evidence is plant-, feedstock-, process-, atmosphere- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level explosion or poisoning probability.
Hydrogen and CCUS risk depends on phase, pressure, inventory, materials, containment, detection, ventilation, ignition, pipeline or offshore design and emergency response.
Hydrogen/CCUS evidence is technology-, installation-, phase-, route-, operating-condition- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level major-accident probability.
Offshore hydrogen-sulphide risk depends on concentration, tank conditions, biological activity, venting, wind, monitoring, maintenance and worker location.
Offshore H2S evidence is installation-, tank-, concentration-, weather-, task- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level toxic-exposure probability.
DSEAR risk depends on substance properties, inventory, process, containment, release frequency, ventilation, ignition sources, occupancy and emergency arrangements.
Dangerous-substance evidence is substance-, process-, installation-, environment- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
